verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the original. The can, logo and headline are tiny, 'Explore Flavours' in the button is barely legible at this size, the sun icon has lost its rays, and big dead areas sit above and below the panel. B rearranges for the tall format with a bold headline and a readable, dominant CTA, but it has clear flaws: the logo is pushed into the bottom-left corner, jammed against the edge and out of the reading order; the panel and button run almost to the canvas edges with no margins; and the can sits right on the panel's top edge.
